question: The Arya Samaj was founded by Dayanand Saraswati in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1875**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Arya Samaj** was founded by Swami Dayanand Saraswati.
 
• The Arya Samaj was established on **10 April 1875**.
 
• Swami Dayanand Saraswati was a prominent Hindu religious leader and reformer.
 
• The primary aim of Arya Samaj was to promote values and practices based on the infallibility of the Vedas.
 
• Arya Samaj played a crucial role in the social and religious reform movements in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swami Dayanand Saraswati**

 
 
• Born as Mool Shankar Tiwari on 12 February 1824, he was a Hindu religious scholar and the founder of Arya Samaj.
 
• He emphasized the Vedic ideal of Brahmacharya and opposed idol worship.
 
• His teachings inspired several future leaders and reformers, including Mahatma Gandhi.
 
 
 
• **Principles of Arya Samaj**
 
 
• The organization promotes the idea of monotheism and rejects idol worship.
 
• It advocates for the equal status of all individuals irrespective of caste, creed, or gender.
 
• Emphasis on education, especially for women and the underprivileged, is a cornerstone of Arya Samaj.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Indian Society**
 
 
• Arya Samaj was instrumental in promoting the cause of social reforms such as the abolition of child marriage and the upliftment of the downtrodden.
 
• The movement played a significant role in the independence movement by fostering a sense of national pride and unity.
 
 
 
• **Educational Initiatives**
 
 
• Arya Samaj established several schools and colleges, including DAV (Dayanand Anglo-Vedic) schools and colleges, which continue to operate today.
 
• These institutions focus on imparting value-based education and promoting Vedic culture and knowledge.
